DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names family-config, family=serial, helper=SerialDriver. Every command is assembled at run time from a pump address plus a keyword (for example pump_controler.py:22 '<address>ADR', line 55 '<address>DIR<INF|WDR>', line 60 '<address>RAT<rate><unit>', line 85 '<address>VOL <volume>'), so a SerialDriver command table cannot reproduce the line without changing the wire syntax. The package is a direct Driver over the upstream class (driver-authoring.md, "Choosing the shape"); native.py is an independent Python 3 port and the fake implements the upstream method names. G7 would still fail on the Python 2 source even if it could reach the fake.

PACKAGE COVERAGE: reads flow_rate (uL/min, negative for WDR), direction (forward/reverse), volume (uL) and dispensed_volume (uL, INF); writes flow_rate and volume, both Limit.operator_required because no text file of the clone states a range; action cap.actuation.pump.v1 runs one pump for a volume or duration, converts uL/s to uL/min, sets the rate and volume, resets the dispense counter, runs, waits only on hardware, stops in a finally block, and returns dispensed_volume and duration_s; safe-state action x-cap.nsls-ii-chx.stop_pump.v1 and the @estop write the broadcast STP (pump_controler.py:163-169). The action is long_running and cancellable and checks self.cancelled(). NOT COVERED: the DIA command (pump_controler.py:66-81) is not exposed because the clone states no unit for the diameter; the MH and NH rate labels of get_rate (pump_controler.py:143-148) are not converted because the clone's labels are ambiguous, so the read raises a precondition failure rather than guessing; the Python 2 module is never imported; the hardware backend was never run.

SAFETY: risk is R2 because the pump dispenses liquid (MHS/spec/04-safety.md), above the card's R0 floor. No text file of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop, so the independent stop is the safe_state=True action, which writes the broadcast STP; the @estop writes the same command without waiting for a reply. The safe state is every pump stopped. No physical hardware stop is claimed. The fake is an in-memory stateful stand-in whose start values, address and replies are placeholders, not facts or a recording. site-limits.example.json shows the operator overlay; its ranges only narrow the catalogue field and fill the operator-required fields.
